Logistics Co

To: chartering@elsharkawymaritime.com
Subject: STEEL MENU
Importance: High

 

Attn: Chartering Desk !!!

 

Gd Day,,

 

Please Only Propose Competitive Rated and Suitable Vessels Incl Full
Itinerary/ETA Load Port For:

 

IACS

 

Min 2,000 Mts Wire Rods In Bulk 10 Pct More Chopt 

(Dims: 1.20 (H) X 1.20 (W) X 1.35 M (L) Uw Abt 1.4 Mt 

1 Sbp Alexandria Chopt Abu Qir/1 Sbp Sousse, Tunisia

1,000 Mts Fshex Eiu Thu Noon/Sun 0800 Ntc Eiu

1,000 Mts Fshex Eiu Thu Noon/Sun 0800 Ntc Eiu

Laycan 12-15 May

Freight Usd      Pmt Fios L/S/D 

Chrts Agents Bends

Chrts Exe Gencon Cp 

1.25pct Ttl Comm

 

++

 

Min 5,250 Mts Hrc 5 Pct More Chopt Max 2 Tiers Uw Abt 26 Mt

1 Sbp Alexandria Chopt Abu Qir/1 Sbp Birkenhead, Uk

(Expect 5,330 Mts)

2,000 Mts Fshex Eiu Thu Noon/Sun 0800 Ntc Eiu 

2,000 Mts Sshex Eiu Fri 1700-Mon 0800 Ntc Eiu

Laycan 18-22 May

Freight Usd      Pmt Fios L/S/D 1:1

Chrts Agents Bends

Chrts Exe Gencon Cp

1.25pct Ttl Comm

 

++

 

Min 17,500 Mts Hrc/Pno 5 Pct More Chopt Max 2 Tiers Uw Abt 26 Mt

1 Sbp Alexandria Chopt Abu Qir/1 Sb-2 Sp Gemlik And Yildiz Entegre 

(Expect Gemlik 12,700 Mts And Yildiz Entegre: 5,000 Mts)

3,000 Mts Fshex Eiu Thu Noon/Sun 0800 Ntc Eiu 

4,000 Mts Sshex Eiu Fri 1700-Mon 0800 Ntc Eiu

Laycan 19-22 May

Freight Usd      Pmt Fios L/S/D 1:2

Chrts Agents Bends

Chrts Exe Gencon Cp

1.25pct Ttl Comm

 

Brgds // 

Capt.Mohamed Elsharkawy

Tels: +20663232456/3232457

Fax:  +20663232459

Mob: +201007800552 (24hrs)

chartering@elsharkawymaritime.com
